title: Pişmanlıklar
canDo: Geçmişteki kararları ve olayları third conditional ile değerlendirebilir, şimdiki ve geçmişteki pişmanlıklarımı wish ve if only ile ifade edebilir, başkalarının davranışlarından duyduğum rahatsızlığı wish + would ile dile getirebilirim.
grammar: third conditional (if + past perfect, would have + V3)
could have / might have ile third conditional

liveClass.title: Keşke...
liveClass.goal: Öğrenciler hayatlarındaki bir dönüm noktasını (bir okul seçimi, bir taşınma, bir tesadüf) anlatır ve partneri If you hadn't..., would you have...? sorularıyla "alternatif hayatı" keşfeder. İkinci bölümde gruplar I wish... / If only... cümleleriyle küçük ve büyük pişmanlıklarını paylaşır ve birbirlerine tavsiye verir. Son olarak sınıf "pişmanlık mı, ders mi?" sorusunu tartışır.

lessons.title: Olsaydı, olurdu
lessons.goal: Geçmişte olmayan bir durumu ve onun hayali sonucunu third conditional ile anlatabilirim.

discover.title: Bir tesadüfün hikâyesi
discover.body:
Twelve years ago, Nazlı missed her train to Ankara by thirty seconds.

"I was furious," she remembers. "I had an important exam the next morning. I had to wait two hours for the next train."

While she was waiting, she started talking to a young man who was reading her favourite novel. His name was Tarık.

"If I hadn't missed that train, I would never have met him," Nazlı says. "And if we hadn't started talking about that book, we wouldn't have discovered how much we had in common."

Today, they are married with two children, and they run a small bookshop together. "If the train had been on time," Tarık laughs, "I'd probably have spent that evening reading alone!"

questions.prompt: Why was Nazlı furious at first?
What were they talking about?

learn.explanation:
**Third conditional**, geçmişte **gerçekleşmemiş** bir durumu ve onun **hayali sonucunu** anlatır. Geçmiş değiştirilemez, bu yüzden tamamen hayalidir.

| If + **past perfect** | , **would have** + V3 |
|---|---|
| If I **hadn't missed** the train, | I **would never have met** him. |
| If you **had studied** harder, | you **would have passed**. |
| If it **had rained**, | we **wouldn't have gone** to the beach. |

**Gerçekte ne oldu?**

- If I **hadn't missed** the train ... → Gerçekte treni **kaçırdım**.
- ... I **would never have met** him. → Gerçekte onunla **tanıştım**.

**Kısaltmalar (konuşmada):**

- If I**'d** known, I**'d have** told you. (**'d** = had / would)
- would have → **would've** /ˈwʊdəv/

**Soru:** What **would** you **have done** if you **had lost** your job?

**Dikkat:** if kısmında would kullanılmaz: ~~If I would have known~~

examples.en: If I'd known you were coming, I'd have made a cake.
We wouldn't have got lost if we'd taken a map.
What would you have done if you hadn't gone to university?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "bilseydim ... yapardım" yapısı hem second hem third conditional anlamına gelebilir; bağlamdan anlarız. İngilizcede geçmiş için mutlaka past perfect + would have + V3 kullanılır. "If I knew, I would tell you" (şu an bilmiyorum) ile "If I had known, I would have told you" (o zaman bilmiyordum) farklıdır. Ayrıca "I'd" kısaltmasının iki anlamı vardır: if kısmında had, sonuç kısmında would.

options: If I knew, I'd tell you.
If I had known, I would have told you.
If I would have studied, I would have passed.
If I had studied, I would have passed.

learn.explanation:
Third conditional'ın sonuç kısmında would have yerine **could have** ya da **might have** kullanılabilir:

| Modal | Anlam | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **would have** + V3 | kesin hayali sonuç | If we'd scored, we **would have won**. |
| **might have** + V3 | olası sonuç (belki) | If we'd scored, we **might have won**. |
| **could have** + V3 | yetenek / olanak | If I'd been calm, I **could have scored**. |

**Olumsuz:**

- **wouldn't have** = olmazdı
- **might not have** = olmayabilirdi
- **couldn't have** = olamazdı / yapamazdım

**Tek başına could have / might have:** Koşul cümlesi olmadan da kaçırılan fırsatları ya da tehlikeleri anlatır:

- You **could have** told me! (Bana söyleyebilirdin! → Söylemedin, kızgınım.)
- Be careful! You **might have** hurt yourself. (Kendine zarar verebilirdin.)

**if'siz third conditional (konuşmada):**

- **Without** your help, I **wouldn't have** finished. (= If you hadn't helped me ...)
- **But for** the rain, we'd have gone. (resmî)

examples.en: If I'd left five minutes earlier, I might have caught the bus.
examples.tr: Beş dakika erken çıksaydım otobüsü yakalayabilirdim belki.

lessons.title: Keşke şimdi...
lessons.goal: wish ve if only ile şimdiki durumlardan duyduğum pişmanlığı ve özlemi ifade edebilirim.

discover.title: Sosyal medyada bir paylaşım
discover.body:
Monday morning thoughts...

I wish I didn't have to go to work today. I wish I lived by the sea and could swim every morning instead of sitting in traffic for an hour.

If only I had more free time! I wish I knew how to play the guitar, and I wish I could speak Italian.

But then I look at my daughter, who's still asleep, and I think: I wish she weren't growing up so fast.

OK, enough dreaming. Coffee time! #mondaymood

questions.prompt: What does the writer wish about their daughter?
options: That she weren't growing up so fast
questions.explanation: "I wish she weren't growing up so fast"

learn.explanation:
**wish / if only + past simple** → **şu anki** bir durumun farklı olmasını isteriz ("keşke ... olsa").

| Gerçek (şimdi) | Dilek |
|---|---|
| I **have** to go to work. | I wish I **didn't have** to go to work. |
| I **don't live** by the sea. | I wish I **lived** by the sea. |
| I **can't** speak Italian. | I wish I **could** speak Italian. |
| She **is** growing up so fast. | I wish she **weren't** growing up so fast. |

Zaman **bir adım geriye** gider: present → past, can → could, is -ing → was/were -ing.

**be fiili:** Resmî dilde tüm kişilerde **were**: I wish I **were** taller. (Günlük dilde **was** da kullanılır.)

**if only** = wish'in daha **güçlü, duygusal** hali:

- **If only** I had more time! (Keşke daha fazla vaktim olsaydı!)

**Dikkat:** Gelecekte gerçekçi olarak olmasını istediğimiz şeyler için **hope** kullanılır:

- I **hope** it **stops** raining. (Olabilir.) ≠ I **wish** it **wasn't** raining. (Şu an yağıyor.)

examples.en: I wish I had a bigger flat.
examples.tr: Keşke daha büyük bir dairem olsa.

examples.en: I wish it weren't so cold today.
examples.tr: Keşke bugün bu kadar soğuk olmasa.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "keşke" kelimesinden sonra genellikle "-sa / -saydı" eki gelir. İngilizcede şimdiki durumlar için wish + past simple kullanılır; fiil geçmiş zamanda olsa da anlam şimdiyi anlatır. "I wish I have more money" yanlıştır; doğrusu "I wish I had more money".

options: I wish I have more money.
I wish I had more money.
I wish you pass your exam.
I hope you pass your exam.

lessons.title: Keşke yapmasaydım
lessons.goal: wish / if only + past perfect ile geçmişteki pişmanlıkları, wish + would ile başkalarının davranışlarına duyduğum rahatsızlığı ifade edebilirim.

learn.explanation:
**1. wish / if only + past perfect** → **geçmişteki** bir pişmanlık ("keşke ... yapsaydım / yapmasaydım")

| Gerçek (geçmiş) | Pişmanlık |
|---|---|
| I **booked** that hotel. | I wish I **hadn't booked** that hotel. |
| I **didn't read** the reviews. | If only I **had read** the reviews! |
| I **said** something stupid. | I wish I **hadn't said** that. |

**should have** ile benzer anlam:

- I wish I **had studied** more. ≈ I **should have studied** more.

**2. wish + would** → başkasının (ya da bir durumun) **sürekli davranışından şikâyet** ve değişmesini istemek

- I wish my brother **would** listen to me. (Hiç dinlemiyor, sinir oluyorum.)
- I wish it **would** stop raining! (Durmuyor!)
- I wish you **wouldn't** leave your clothes on the floor.

**Dikkat:** Kendimiz için wish + would kullanılmaz: ~~I wish I would~~ → I wish I **could** ...

**Özet:**

| Yapı | Zaman | Anlam |
|---|---|---|
| wish + past simple | şimdi | Keşke ... olsa |
| wish + past perfect | geçmiş | Keşke ... olsaydı |
| wish + would | başkasının davranışı | Keşke ... yapsa (şikâyet) |
| wish + could | yetenek | Keşke ... yapabilsem |

examples.en: I wish I hadn't eaten so much.
If only we had left earlier!
I wish you wouldn't interrupt me all the time.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "Keşke o oteli ayırtmasaydım" ve "Keşke beni dinlese" cümleleri aynı "keşke" ile kurulur. İngilizcede ilki wish + past perfect (geçmiş pişmanlık), ikincisi wish + would (başkasından şikâyet) ile ifade edilir. wish + would genellikle bir sitem tonu taşır.

lessons.title: Pişmanlık mı, ders mi?
lessons.goal: Geçmiş kararları dengeli bir şekilde değerlendirebilir, pişmanlıkları ve çıkarılan dersleri bir yazıda bir araya getirebilirim.

discover.title: Röportaj: "Pişman değilim"
discover.body:
At 45, Gökhan Demir left his job as a bank manager to become a farmer. We asked him about the decision.

"People ask me if I regret it. Honestly? Sometimes. In the first year, I made every mistake possible. If I'd done a course in agriculture first, I wouldn't have lost so much money. I wish I'd been more patient.

But in hindsight, I'm glad I took the risk. If I had played it safe, I would have spent the rest of my life wondering 'what if?'

My advice? Don't spend your life wishing things were different. Learn from your mistakes, and don't be afraid of second chances. The only real regret is the chance you never took."

questions.prompt: What does Gökhan wish he had done?
What would have happened if he had played it safe?
options: He would have spent his life wondering 'what if?'
He would have become a farmer anyway.
questions.explanation: "I would have spent the rest of my life wondering 'what if?'"

learn.explanation:
**Geçmiş kararları değerlendirmek için kalıplar:**

| Duygu | Kalıp |
|---|---|
| **Pişmanlık** | I **regret** + -ing / I **wish I'd** ... / I **should have** ... |
| **Memnuniyet** | I'm **glad** I + past simple / I **don't regret** + -ing / It was **the best decision** ... |
| **Rahatlama** | I'm **relieved** I didn't ... / **Thank goodness** I ... |
| **Ders** | I've **learned** that ... / **In hindsight**, ... / **Looking back**, ... |
| **Kabullenme** | **It's too late now.** / **There's no point in** + -ing / **What's done is done.** |

**regret + -ing:**

- I **regret leaving** school early. (Okulu erken bıraktığım için pişmanım.)
- I **don't regret taking** the risk.

**Dengeli bir değerlendirme yazısı:**

1. **Kararı tanıtın**: Ne oldu, ne zaman?
2. **Olumsuz tarafı**: wish / third conditional
3. **Olumlu tarafı**: I'm glad ... / If I hadn't ..., I wouldn't have ...
4. **Ders ve sonuç**: In hindsight / I've learned that ...

examples.en: I regret not travelling more when I was young.
examples.tr: Gençken daha fazla seyahat etmediğim için pişmanım.

examples.en: I'm glad I didn't accept that offer.
There's no point in worrying about it now.
examples.tr: Şimdi bunun için endişelenmenin anlamı yok.

learn.turkishNote: "Pişmanım" için "I'm regret" demek yaygın bir hatadır; regret bir fiildir: I regret it. "... yapmadığım için pişmanım" ise "I regret not doing ..." olur. "There's no point in" kalıbından sonra -ing gelir: There's no point in crying.

options: I regret to not travel more.
I'm glad I took the job.
I wish I took the job.

The Year I Said No

Five years ago, I was offered a job in London. The salary was double what I was earning in Izmir, and it was a big international company. After a week of thinking, I said no.

At first, I regretted it terribly. I wish I had been braver. If I had accepted, my English would have improved much faster, and I might have climbed the career ladder more quickly. Every time I saw my friends' photos from abroad, I thought: that could have been me.

But in hindsight, I'm glad I stayed. Six months later, my father became seriously ill. If I had been in London, I couldn't have looked after him, and I would never have forgiven myself. I also wouldn't have met my wife, who joined my company that year.

I don't regret my decision any more. I've learned that there's no point in comparing your life with an imaginary one. Every choice has a cost, and the "perfect" path doesn't exist. What matters is that you make your decisions honestly, and then make the best of them.

questions.modelAnswer:
The moment that changed my life was a phone call from my aunt when I was nineteen. She asked if I wanted to help in her small hotel in Kaş for the summer. I almost said no, because I'd planned to work in my father's shop in Ankara.

If I hadn't said yes, I would never have discovered how much I love the sea and meeting people from all over the world. I wouldn't have learned English so quickly, and I might never have studied tourism. I certainly wouldn't have met my best friend, Lena, who was staying at the hotel with her family.

Of course, there are things I wish I'd done differently. I wish I had spent more time with my father during those years, because he needed help in the shop. If only I had understood that then!

But overall, I'm glad I took the chance. I don't regret leaving Ankara at all. Today, I run my own guesthouse, and every summer I think about that phone call and smile.
